official_forecast.label: Nowflation CPI Forecast
official_forecast.method: fmc_ensemble (inverse-error-weighted blend of the in-house bottom-up nowcast, Cleveland Fed, and Street — each weighted by its own graded track record)

validation.note: Leakage-free walk-forward over a COMMON window (all components present each print); each print's ensemble weights use only prior prints' graded errors. The ensemble is ~30% tighter than our in-house model and just behind Cleveland/Street individually — published because it's our own construction and more robust, not because it beats every component.

grading_rule: Graded against the BLS first-release headline CPI YoY (NSA, one decimal). The standing forecast updates daily as data lands; the value the day before release is the graded call (vintage-true), consistent with our backtest methodology. This file is the dated, immutable record that the forecast was on the tape before the print.
audit_trail: Full daily asof-dated history for every forecaster is preserved in the engine and surfaced on /scoreboard.
